doc: Increments two u16 counters embedded in a small struct at D_80083958 (a CD-related retry/frame-count state block). counter2 (offset 0x8) is unconditionally bumped; counter1 (offset 0x6) is bumped and, once it reaches 0x401 (1025), is reset to 0 and CdInit() is re-issued (a periodic CD reinit / retry-timeout mechanism). The store-then-call source order (`counter1 = 0; CdInit();`) is what lets gcc's own delayed-branch scheduler naturally push that store into the `jal CdInit`'s delay slot -- no maspsx patch needed since the address is already materialized in $a0 and the store is independent of the call.

globals.name: D_80083958
globals.decl: struct S_80083958 { /*0x0*/ u32 unk0; /*0x4*/ u8 unk4; /*0x5*/ u8 unk5; /*0x6*/ u16 counter1; /*0x8*/ u16 counter2; /*0xA*/ u16 flags; } D_80083958; // offsets 0x0/0x4/0x5/0xA inferred from sibling funcs func_8003E34C (word-zero at +0x0, byte-zero at +0x4/+0x5, halfword-zero at +0xA... actually +0xA not touched by E34C, see note) and func_8003E758 (lhu/sh at +0xA as a bitflags halfword, sb at +0x4); this function (func_8003E70C) only touches +0x6 (counter1) and +0x8 (counter2), both u16, confirmed byte-exact.

calls: extern void CdInit(void); // library CD-ROM init function, no args
